description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Kumbaloluwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510258 & other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel No. 113 and Parcel No. 33) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
